name: The Scrapheap
design_intent: SPORTS chaos finale (v8_sports_courts.md tier 5). The hammer_yard shell (2800x1600, strict mirror about x=1400) with the central spinning_hammer PLUS two MIRRORED landmine pairs -> hammer + mines together, goals half-accidental hilarity. SYMMETRY (SC-SYM/SYM-3): the hammer sits ON the centre axis (inherently symmetric); each mine PAIR is a mirror pair at the same y with IDENTICAL params/phase, so no instant pressures one team's half more. NOTE (deviation, reported): the full v8 spec also lists a falling_debris cadence here; this build scopes the finale to hammer+mines (both already interact with the ball) and defers debris ball-punt -- flagged, not silently dropped. SYM-4 (no own-goal machine): mines sit at x1080/1720 (y1180, low) and x1180/1620 (y640, mid), blast_radius 300 -> blasts reach at most x780/x2020, ~470px clear of the goal mouths (x170..310 / x2490..2630); no blast overlaps a goal mouth, so a mine punt sends the ball into open play. Ball-hazard: hammer whacks the ball (~2000px/s), a mine blast PUNTS it (Bomb._punt_balls -> Ball.receive_hazard_impulse, ~1500px/s point-blank), both re-capped to 2400 (chaseable). Fuse mines recur with telegraphed accelerating blink; clear windows remain (hammer dwell + fuse leads). NO powerup_spawners. Skilled power-shots still score (SC-CHAOS) -- chaos ADDS accidents, doesn't replace intent. WK-122: each goal back wall is a short BACK POST spanning the mouth +-100px (was full height = a doubled pillar column outside the court); the 60px slot between it and the post column is narrower than any goat (r >= 39.6) or the ball (r 60), so the pocket stays sealed (WK-122 probe, 100 s of bot play on CENTER PITCH, LONG HAUL and THE BOX: no goat or ball left the mouth band; the other five share the CENTER PITCH pocket).
